_comment: Fixes applied to Material Maker's node definitions when public/data is built (scripts/build-data.mjs). Each entry names a node, a string field in its definition and text replacements in it, with the reason.

patches.reason: The 'bricks' node it includes renamed bricks_*() and brick() to oldbricks_*() and oldbrick(); upstream this node no longer compiles.
brick_uv() was renamed oldbrick_uv() in the 'bricks' node.
brick_corner_uv() was renamed oldbrick_corner_uv() in the 'bricks' node.
